item.title: Starship 13th Test Delayed, Skyroot Vikram‑1 Soars
item.description: SpaceX’s 13th Starship test faces a last‑second abort and new launch date, while India’s Skyroot celebrates Vikram‑1’s successful 280‑mile orbit.
